triggers.detailsText: Our current order book of 2.16 Gigawatt, valued at over Rs 2,250 crores, provides us with strong revenue visibility. Our O&M business also continued its growth trajectory, with revenue of approximately Rs 2.94 crore compared with Rs 1.16 crore last year, while revenue from sale of power stood approximately at Rs 11.78 crore compared with Rs 10.14 crore in Q1 FY26. Q4 FY26 was the highest quarterly revenue reported by the company at Rs 633.93 crore and Q1 FY27 delivered Rs 520.97 crore, approximately 82% of that exceptional base.
